reasons.regional_outage: ap-northeast shows a 14.2% payment API error rate, degraded status, failing synthetic checkout, and ~310 affected merchants, so customer-visible payment failures are very likely in that region.
reasons.response_plan: A customer-visible payment degradation began minutes after a release reached 100% of one region, so declaring the top severity and paging the incident commander is the strongest coordinated first-ten-minutes move.
reasons.technical_spread: The fault is confined to one region and one service (plus its queue/synthetic symptoms), matching a clearly degraded single region with slight tail risk it is worse than observed.
